title: Resume extraction result (v1)
description: Structured data extracted from one resume. null = not present in resume.

candidate_name.description: Candidate's full name as written in the resume; null if not found.

skills.description: Concrete tools/technologies/hard skills mentioned. Empty array if none.

years_of_experience.description: Total years computed from explicit employment date ranges only; null if not determinable.

strengths.description: Factual strong points the resume itself supports.

gaps.description: Factual notes about what is demonstrably missing from the resume.
